title: Network Analysis
description: Investigate a short synthetic support capture. All traffic was prepared for this exercise.

challenges.title: Find the portal
challenges.goal: Find the DNS answer for portal.training.test, then inspect its first HTTP response.
hints: Read topology.txt and open support-session.pcap with tshark -r.
Use a display filter with -Y dns or -Y http. No live capture is needed.

challenges.title: Follow the conversation
challenges.goal: Locate the HTTP response header that carries the next flag.
hints: Use tshark -r /evidence/network-analysis/support-session.pcap -Y http -V to inspect HTTP details.
You can follow a TCP stream with tshark -r FILE -q -z follow,tcp,ascii,STREAM_NUMBER.

challenges.title: Reassemble the handover
challenges.goal: Export the handover text file transferred over HTTP and read its flag.
hints: HTTP data may span packets; object export reassembles it.
Create a directory in /work and use tshark -r FILE --export-objects http,/work/exported. These deliberately plaintext HTTP examples do not imply HTTPS can normally be read this way.
